documentTypes.label: Income Tax Returns — Manual Filing
documentTypes.description: Triggers for manually filed ITR documents and stamps
documentTypes.note: Stamp check: For genuine ITR filed mid-year, stamp will generally be blurred. Those filed at start of financial year will be clear. If deposited in ward → ITO stamp. In circle → DC or ACIT stamp. All wards in a range must have same stamp shape per year.

Return not filed by a CA / CA's seal does not exist on return
Acknowledgement copy used as proof for AY 1998-99 or 1999-00 is suspicious — SARAL form required from AY 1998-99 onwards
PAN No. not mentioned in SARAL form from year 2003-2004 onwards
Signature mismatch
ITR not filed in same city as given address (IT dept very strict on this)
Serial no. exceeds 6 digits maximum; generally max 6 digits
Two ITRs given together, deposited in different years with close resemblance in stamp and serial no.
Address of applicant and ward no. mismatch
Serial No. mismatch with the month in which ITR is filed
Seal of IT Department fake or entries tampered with
Indentation in entries indicating writing done over whitener-erased content
Mismatch between declared income and tax calculated

Advance tax not paid for high income category
ITR filed on a holiday
Name / address / DOB mismatch
PAN / GIR No. not mentioned
PAN / GIR mismatch

Salaried person filing ITR in non-salaried ward. No business person in Range 11&6 (salaried only from AY 1999-2000)

documentTypes.label: Income Tax Returns — E-Filed (ITR-V)
documentTypes.description: Electronic filing verification — AY 09-10 and AY 10-11
documentTypes.infoNote: E-filing Acknowledgment number is 15 digits total; last 6 digits are the date of filing. For AY 08-09 and before, local manual triggers apply. Hard copy must be sent to Bangalore CPC within 30 days (if filed before 31st July) or 60 days (if after 1st August).

documentTypes.label: PAN & TAN Coding Logic
documentTypes.description: Structure, breakdown and verification rules for PAN and TAN

pan.title: PAN — Permanent Account Number
pan.rule: 10 chars: 5 alphabetical · 4 numeric · 1 alphabetical check digit

tan.title: TAN — Tax Deduction & Collection Account Number
tan.rule: 10 chars: First 3 = zone · 4th = deductor name · 5-9 numeric · 10 = category

documentTypes.label: PAN Card — Document Triggers
documentTypes.description: Physical PAN card fraud detection checks

triggers.text: PAN format check: 10 characters — first 5 alphabets, next 4 numerals, last alphabet (check digit)
5th character must be first alphabet of applicant's surname (individual) or firm name (non-individual)
Address in ITR does not match Voter ID, Aadhaar, Passport, or application form
4th character status code mismatch with applicant type (P=Person, C=Company, H=HUF, F=Firm, A=AOP, T=Trust, B=BOI, L=Local, J=Juridical, G=Govt)
Age at PAN issue date must be 18+ years; if less, must be a minor PAN card
Date of issue of PAN must not hugely differ from DOB; also check PAN series
PAN card of "B" series onwards must be coloured — B, C, D, E & F series cannot be black and white
Customer name and father's name mismatch with Passport, Voter ID, Aadhaar, or application form
Logo of Indian Government missing in latest PAN cards
Signature mismatch with self-attestation and application form
QR code missing or invalid on PAN card
Same type of photo pasted in multiple KYC documents — trigger flag

documentTypes.label: Aadhaar Card

triggers.text: No record found on UIDAI online site
State, age slab, or gender does not match with UIDAI online data
Photo mismatch from application form
Check name / address with original document
Name and address mismatch across documents
Aadhaar number mismatch on name side vs address side
Photo seems pasted on Aadhaar card
Others
Standalone Aadhaar card with cell number mismatch and CIBIL score 0 & -1
12-digit Aadhaar number must match on both sides of the card
Year of birth must tally with all other documents
Photo tampering / pasting / same photo used in other KYC documents
Address state must match with UIDAI online record
QR code must be scanned and verified against card data

documentTypes.label: Voter ID Card (EPIC)
documentTypes.description: Technical and non-technical verification triggers

triggers.text: No record or mismatch in record as per Election Commission online site
Photo mismatch on online site compared to application form / Voter ID card
Photo seems pasted on Voter ID card
Voter ID card font / alignment mismatch across pages
Two different Voter ID numbers on front and back side (not applicable with new cards)
Others
Photograph always computerized — must reasonably match application form photo
Font must match on front and second page of card
EPIC number must match on front and back side of card
Since year 2000, serial no. (top right) appears on both sides of card
Date in "Age as on" field must always be less than "Date of Issue"
Difference between Date of Issue and "Age as on" must never exceed 1.5 years
Fonts used: Arial and Times New Roman (size 8/10). Other fonts are suspicious
Signature of issuing authority on back / second side is stamped
Photo dimensions: 3cm(L) × 2.3cm(B) — verify if unusual size
All headings / fields must be in English & regional language of issuing state

documentTypes.label: Driving License
documentTypes.description: DL verification triggers and validity rules

triggers.text: Initial digits of DL not tallying with year of issuance
DL validity: 20 years if age <35 yrs, else 15 years; or until holder reaches 50 (whichever earlier). Commercial vehicle DL renewed every 3 years
Major difference between Date of Birth (DOB) and Date of Issue (DOI)
Photo pasted on driving license
Manipulated document
Age eligibility: 18 yrs (16 for ≤50cc without gear, with guardian consent); 20 for commercial vehicle
